verdict.rationale: Resend documents webhooks for real-time email event notifications and an API-retrievable list of links clicked in a broadcast, which touches click tracking. There is no evidence of open tracking or of a per-message event history endpoint for answering 'what happened to this email?'. missing for 10: documented open tracking, a per-message event history/timeline API endpoint, per-email (non-broadcast) click data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track opens and clicks and query a per-message event history via the API to answer 'what happened to this email?'

citations.quote: Retrieve the links clicked in a broadcast
Create a webhook to receive real-time notifications about email events.
configure webhooks, and monitor delivery events.
